<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/rest/report/chats"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the individual messages of up to **10 conversations** at a time, together with
the conversation records they belong to.

Obtain the conversation UUIDs from **Get conversations data**.

Each message record has a `type`, which decides what `message` holds and which extra
properties are present:

| `type` | `message` holds | Extra properties |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `chat` | What the customer or agent typed in the conversation | — |
| `note` | What the agent typed in an internal note | — |
| `assigned` | What the agent typed in the transfer note | `assignedQueue`, `assignedAgent` |
| `closed` | A system-generated message, for example `Agent <AGENT_NAME> closed` | `disposition` |
